text: FIX `graphQLSchemaFromRxSchema()` threw an error of the `get-graphql-from-jsonschema` dependency when the schema contains a `type` list like `['string', 'null']`. A `type` list with `null` now creates a nullable GraphQL field. ADD a dev-mode check that throws the RxError `GQL5` with the collection and the field path when a field has no GraphQL type (an object without `properties`, an array without `items`, a field without `type`).
